text:
marissa: heads up — a few interviewers just reported they can't submit scorecards. getting a 403 from the ATS submit endpoint. seems to coincide with last night's training-cert webhook run.
jin: can you DM sample user ids? also sending logs to #eng-oncall.
marissa: @jin list: U1432, U1578, U1990 — all show 'permission denied' when trying to POST /scorecards. ticket created: REQ-4821.
aaron: recruiters are getting panicked — panel scheduled tonight and we need results. any quick unblock? :grimacing:
sasha: is this the webhook that marks certs expired and removes the 'can_score' role?
marissa: yes. it processed ~700 certs at 02:12 UTC. webhooks.log shows event: CERT_EXPIRE_BATCH with filter tag=training_v2.
jin: looking at auth-service logs — I see a job calling permissions-service: revoke_role for role=interviewer:can_score with batch_id=cert-expire-2026-04-10.
dbadmin: I can run a query to check state. suggested quick fix: reapply can_score for recent active interviewers if their cert actually still valid.
jin: quick SQL to regrant for listed ids:
```
UPDATE user_roles SET role='interviewer:can_score', updated_at=now() WHERE user_id IN ('U1432','U1578','U1990') AND role <> 'interviewer:can_score';
```
marissa: pls run that, @dbadmin, but only after we snapshot current role table.
dbadmin: snapshot taken (s3://backups/roles/2026-04-10-0215.sql). running update now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: perms-fix-rollback at 2026-04-10T02:35:12Z by jin.
aaron: thanks! i'll tell interviewers to try submitting again in 5m.
sasha: long term, we need the webhook to check cert status against the canonical training table before revoking. looks like a mismatch between training_v2 and training_master.
jin: confirmed — webhook filter used training_v2 tag but canonical is training_master; some users still in master. bug introduced in 2025-11 when training pipeline renamed. adding a guard now.
marissa: can we add a safety: do not revoke scoring role if user had a scorecard activity in last 30 days?
jin: yes, adding that rule to the revoke job. patch ready, will go through canary.
dbadmin: permissions restored for U1432,U1578,U1990 — verified.
aaron: interviewers can submit now, verified by panel owner. :tada:
sasha: filing followup tasks: OPS-912 sync script to reconcile training_v2 vs training_master, OPS-913 add audit log for revoke events, OPS-914 add 30-day activity guard.
marissa: thanks all. can we do a short retro tomorrow 11am to avoid repeat?
jin: yep. I'll include timeline and proposed fix in the retro deck.
marissa: adding attendees: @sasha @jin @aaron. good catch, @dbadmin and deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: incident recorded: INC-2026-045.
